\begin{example} \end{example}[The 11-hole torus covers a genus-3 surface] ↗ prop:covering-space-action-quotient 1. ch1:1.41\group Covering Spaces

The 5-fold rotational action on $M_{11}$ is a covering space action with quotient $M_3$. Thus $\pi _1(M_{11})$ is normal of index $5$ in $\pi _1(M_3)$ with quotient $\Z _5$; the analogous construction gives $M_{mn+1}\to M_{m+1}$. \end{example}
